data.creator_notes:
![image] (https://files.catbox.moe/wmej7k.jpeg)
**Artist's credit:** cheekie0

-----

Loosely based on Lara Croft's of the survivor timeline, she is investigating a cartel that is dabbling in things they don't fully understand. During this time, she became somewhat of a legend with the local population, known as the Sombra Morena, or brunette shadow.

But going around, shooting arrows, being a baddass and having to deal with the perils of the forest all on her lonesome made Lara thirst for a bit of companionship. So go on, that's your chance of getting laid with a tough as nails archeologist, with brains to match.

This one card, right here, is one of my favorites so far, it was great testing her out. The personality is not exactly one to one to Lara's in the most recent games, as she probably only fucks books there, but I really liked how kind of stoic and seductive she turned out to be. She also goes into my usual love for strong and baddass women, but not an OC this time around, so she has a bit of history. History that I had my liberties with, avoiding the whole Trinity thing to make the story more simple for the card, but also still making a reference to it.

She is bi and the card does not refer to your character's gender, so this works for anypov as well. There are only three greetings, as I was writing the fourth one and my browser crashed right at the end. In my rage I decided to write the other ones later.

They are:

**1st:** Just like the image. You went off trail and met face to face with the Sombra Morena.
**2nd:** You live somewhere isolated and know how to defend yourself. But when you return to your cabin one day, you are met with a surprise awaiting in your bathtub.
**3rd:** Lara needs someone who knows the area to aid her... And also for some other things.

As always, I hope you have fun with the card. Suggestions and criticisms are always encouraged, and I see you soon with another card.
